name: Shihen 69 ~Shin'en no Messiah~
source:
There is an old sacred book, in which everything that has happened in history is written down. But, one chapter was so dangerous that it had been divided, sealed and hidden throughout the land. One day, a king began to search for this sealed chapter. Felix, who is from a family with long ties to the book, joins the campaign, and as if led by fate meets five others.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071101044929/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/7919]Himeya Shop[/url]]
translation:
世上有一部古老圣典，记载着历史上发生的一切。然而，其中有一章内容过于危险，因而被拆分、封印，并藏在大地各处。某天，一名国王开始寻找这段被封印的篇章。出身于世代与圣典关系密切家族的菲利克斯加入搜索，并仿佛受到命运指引般遇见了另外五个人。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071101044929/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/7919]Himeya Shop[/url]]
